newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Gold starts steady in Europe, seen drifting up.
newsitem.headline: Gold starts steady in Europe, seen drifting up.

text.p: Gold opened little changed in calm trading on Thursday and dealers said they expected it to drift higher in an oversold market despite continuing bearish sentiment.
"I think we have seen the lows and the next move is toward $325," one dealer at a major Swiss bank said. Selling would eventually resume, but probably not this week, he said.
Another Zurich trader saw prices headed for $320 now, with gold likely to consolidate between $315 and $322. Any break below $315 would push gold sharply lower, he said.
Gold opened at $319.40/$319.80, down just a tad from $319.50/320.00 at the London close.
